words.example: A talking point for Monday is the long queue at registration.
words.exampleZh: 周一的一个讨论要点是挂号处排长队。

words.example: Salary questions went to the parking lot so we could finish on time.
words.exampleZh: 薪资问题放进了待议事项，会议才能准时结束。

words.example: The workshop on difficult conversations is limited to sixteen people.
words.exampleZh: 关于难谈话的研讨会限十六人参加。

words.example: Please keep phones away during the afternoon session of the offsite.
words.exampleZh: 外出研讨的下午场，请把手机收起来。

words.example: Staff may submit questions for the town hall by Wednesday.
words.exampleZh: 员工可以在周三前提交想在全员大会上问的问题。

words.meaning: 个人健康档案（Personal Health Record）
words.example: PHR (Personal Health Record) lets this patient read his lab history at home.
words.exampleZh: PHR（个人健康档案）让这位患者在家查看自己的检验历史。

words.meaning: 医学影像标准（Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine）
words.example: DICOM (Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine) rejected the study from the new CT.
words.exampleZh: DICOM（医学影像标准）拒收了这台新CT传上来的检查。

words.meaning: 医疗信息交换标准（Health Level Seven）
words.example: HL7 (Health Level Seven) dropped the result because a required field was empty.
words.exampleZh: HL7（医疗信息交换标准）因为必填字段是空的，把这条结果丢掉了。

words.meaning: 快速医疗互操作资源（Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources）
words.example: FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) carried the allergy list to the regional platform.
words.exampleZh: FHIR（快速医疗互操作资源）把过敏列表送到了区域平台。

words.meaning: 医疗集成规范（Integrating the Healthcare Enterprise）
words.example: We follow IHE (Integrating the Healthcare Enterprise) when PACS shares studies with the region.
words.exampleZh: 影像系统向区域共享检查时，我们遵循IHE（医疗集成规范）。
